thoughts.sr: Prividno pomeranje PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 pripada satima koje izvor označava, a čiji je odnos prema stvarnom UTC izričito neizvestan, pa ne može da odredi trenutno stanje. SEPA je poslednji put primljena pre 53 min, dok je prijem senzora građana noviji, ali nijedna činjenica ne daje poređenje njihovih merenja. [F3][F5][F7][F9][F2][F10]
thoughts.en: The apparent movement in PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 belongs to source-labelled hours whose relation to true UTC is explicitly uncertain, so it cannot locate a current condition [F3][F5][F7][F9]. SEPA was last received 53 min ago, while citizen-sensor reception is newer, but neither fact supplies a comparison of their measurements [F2][F10].
hypotheses: Perhaps the source-label offset accounts for the apparent mismatch between the labelled hour and the estimated true UTC [F3].
questions: What measurement times and values accompany the newer citizen-sensor reception [F10]?
hypotheses_sr: Možda pomak oznake izvora objašnjava prividno neslaganje između označenog sata i procenjenog stvarnog UTC [F3].
questions_sr: Koja vremena merenja i vrednosti prate noviji prijem senzora građana [F10]?
thoughts.next_check: Check whether SEPA supplies a reception with a labelled hour whose timing can be reconciled with true UTC [F2][F3].

thoughts.sr_refused: SEPA kasni 54 minuta od prijema, a njen poslednji označeni sat procenjen je na 16:00 po stvarnom UTC vremenu, a ne kao trenutno stanje. U okviru pomeranja koje izvor označava od 17:00 do 18:00, maksimum PM10 opao je sa 59 na 40 µg/m³, dok je NO2 porastao sa 43 na 61 µg/m³, a PM2.5 sa 17 na 20 µg/m³; ovo razilaženje vredi proveriti, umesto nazvati sve vrednosti podjednako visokim. [F2][F3][F5][F7][F9][F48]
thoughts.en: SEPA is now 54 min since reception, and its latest labelled hour is estimated as 16:00 true UTC rather than a current condition [F2][F3]. Within the source-labelled move from 17:00 to 18:00, the PM10 maximum fell from 59 to 40 µg/m³ while NO2 rose from 43 to 61 µg/m³ and PM2.5 from 17 to 20 µg/m³, a divergence worth checking rather than calling uniformly high [F5][F7][F9][F48].
hypotheses: Maybe the divergence reflects pollutant-specific conditions rather than a single shared change, if the source-labelled hours are internally comparable [F3][F5][F7][F9].
questions: Will the next SEPA reception preserve the opposite direction between PM10 and NO2 maxima [F5][F7]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA station maxima and verify the interpretation of its labelled hour [F3][F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: SEPA prijem je sada star 79 min, dok je tok senzora građana primljen pre 17 min. U novo primljenom SEPA zapisu, maksimumi označenih sati promenili su se različito za PM10, NO2 i PM2.5. [F2][F10][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: SEPA’s reception is now 79 min old, while the citizen-sensor feed arrived 17 min ago [F2][F10]. In the newly received SEPA record, the labelled-hour maxima changed differently across PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 [F5][F7][F9].
thoughts.next_check: Check the next SEPA reception against the source-labelled hour.

thoughts.sr: SEPA je stigla pre 103 min, dok je Sensor.Community stigao pre 13 min. Parking Servis pokazuje najveću prikazanu promenu na Parkiralištu "Ada", od 510 do 642, ali ne daje vreme merenja. Tanjug nema ništa u poslednjih 6 h. [F2][F10][F11][F12][F13]
thoughts.en: SEPA arrived 103 min ago, while Sensor.Community arrived 13 min ago [F2][F10]. Parking Servis shows its largest displayed change at Parkiralište "Ada", from 510 to 642, but gives no measurement time [F11][F12]. Tanjug has nothing in the last 6 h [F13].
thoughts.next_check: Check the next receptions from SEPA and Parking Servis.

thoughts.sr: Promena parkiranja je samo poređenje između prijema, a Parking Servis ne objavljuje vreme merenja; ne može smestiti pomeranje sa 510 na 642 u vreme grada. Prijem SEPA je star 104 min, dok se označeni sat i procenjeni stvarni UTC razilaze, pa prikazano pomeranje PM10 nije trenutno stanje. [F11][F12][F2][F3]
thoughts.en: The parking change is only a comparison between receptions, and Parking Servis publishes no measurement time; it cannot locate the move from 510 to 642 in the city’s time [F11][F12]. SEPA’s reception is 104 min old, while its labelled hour and estimated true UTC diverge, so the displayed PM10 movement is not a current condition [F2][F3].
thoughts.next_check: Check whether a later SEPA reception resolves the gap between its labelled hour and estimated true UTC.

thoughts.sr: Oštriji kontrast je između prijema SEPA pre 104 min i Sensor.Community pre 14 min, pa je građanska mreža svežiji tok podataka o vazduhu, a ne potvrda obrasca zvaničnih stanica. Parking Servis je primljen pre 19 min, ali ta svežina i dalje ne može da datira prikazani pomak sa 510 na 642; odvojeno, najnovija stavka BVK navodi kvar na mreži datiran 2026-09-20. [F2][F10][F11][F12][F19]
thoughts.en: The sharper contrast is between SEPA's reception 104 min ago and Sensor.Community's 14 min ago, so the citizen network is the fresher air-data stream, not confirmation of the official station pattern [F2][F10]. Parking Servis was received 19 min ago, but that recency still cannot date the displayed move from 510 to 642; separately, the newest BVK item names a network fault dated 2026-09-20 [F11][F12][F19].
hypotheses: Perhaps the dated BVK item is advance notice rather than evidence of a fault already occurring [F1][F19].
questions: Do Sensor.Community readings show the same PM10 direction as SEPA's source-labelled change from 59 to 40 µg/m³ [F5][F10]?
hypotheses_sr: Možda je datirana stavka BVK prethodna najava, a ne dokaz da se kvar već događa [F1][F19].
questions_sr: Da li očitavanja Sensor.Community pokazuju isti smer PM10 kao izvorno označena promena SEPA sa 59 na 40 µg/m³ [F5][F10]?
thoughts.next_check: Inspect timestamps and parameters in the next Sensor.Community reception, then compare overlapping locations with SEPA's source-labelled hours [F3][F10].
